description: This Java source file defines the TelemetryAndEventCli class, a Spring component that acts as a client for sending telemetry data or events to Hono's APIs via AMQP. It handles connecting to the message broker, sending messages asynchronously, and printing delivery states.

classes.name: TelemetryAndEventCli
classes.description: A Spring component and CLI client for sending telemetry data or events to Hono's backend over AMQP.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes message sending process upon bean creation; manages message lifecycle and handles success or failure.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Connects to AMQP adapter and sends a message asynchronously, completing the provided CompletableFuture upon success or failure.

methods.name: printDelivery
methods.description: Prints the delivery state details to the console, including error conditions if the message was rejected.
